## Merge checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and affected owners have reviewed shared changes.
- [ ] Documentation/configuration/contracts match the delivered behavior.
- [ ] No data, models, predictions, secrets, or generated bulk artifacts are staged.
- [ ] Inference is reference-free; train/validation/test separation is preserved.
- [ ] Experimental claims use actual evidence; pending work stays unchecked.
- [ ] Independent technical approval obtained and discussions resolved.
